# address region

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:addressRegion`](gmeow-addressRegion.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/addressRegion>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/contacts`](../../slices/contacts.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The region (state, province, or territory) coordinate value of a postal address, expressed along the [`gmeow:axisAddressRegion`](../individuals/gmeow-axisAddressRegion.md) axis of the postal reference frame.

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:PostalAddress`](../classes/gmeow-PostalAddress.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the state, province, or territory line of an address — a coarse, low-sensitivity component safe for broad projection.

### Avoid when

- Avoid forcing a single abbreviation versus full-name form (non-functional — both coexist) and avoid using it for the resolved region place (reached via [`gmeow:addressPlace`](gmeow-addressPlace.md)).

### How to use

- Carry the region as written; it is coarse enough that public projections normally retain it even when finer components are withheld.

### Examples

- ex:home [`gmeow:addressRegion`](gmeow-addressRegion.md) "AB".
